info.name: Hella's Missing
info.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

descriptions.inProgress: Alcaster told me to go to Hella's house in Orbis, to no avail. She wasn't anywhere to be found, as I had to resort to talking to her housekeeper, #bElma#k. According to her, Hella hadn't been home in months, and no one knows where she went or why. She did tell me to go see her best friend, #bJade of El Nath#k, so I should go there immediately.
